You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"May 11 audit midpoint: shard-keeper remains the main work item. Its runbook has six sections; three are complete and three remain. The other services\u2019 one-pagers are in flight, with the remaining work mostly doc review and ownership cleanup."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Comment on doc_runbook_audit_midpoint_2023 with the accurate May 11 shard-keeper and other-service progress.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_runbook_audit_midpoint_2023", "body": "May 11 audit midpoint: shard-keeper remains the main work item. Its runbook has six sections; three are complete and three remain. The other services\u2019 one-pagers are in flight, with the remaining work mostly doc review and ownership cleanup."}, "field_being_checked": "result.comment.body"}

CRITERION:
The comment says three of six shard-keeper runbook sections were complete and three remained on May 11, 2023, while the other service one-pagers were still in document review and ownership cleanup rather than finished.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":true,"reason":"The comment states, “May 11 audit midpoint” and says the shard-keeper runbook “has six sections; three are complete and three remain,” while the other services’ one-pagers are “in flight,” with remaining work in “doc review and ownership cleanup.”"}
